item.title: S1: CASSA Start of Semester Social (SoSS)
item.description:
Start of Semester Social (SoSS)

We started 2025 with a bang, enjoying a very successful start of semester social. 30+ people came and enjoyed a night of games, highlighted by a CASSA and computer science inspired game of Family Feud hosted by our own Steve Harvey, the beloved president Lachlan Marshall.

We look forward to seeing everyone on campus and discord - CASSA committee
